notes: Dual-channel optical transmitter only (no receiver photodetector or RX optical specs). VCCTX supply 3.135 V to 3.465 V per port; +3.3 V per port. Link distances in table are stated in meters (220M, 275M, 300M, 500M, 550M); headline states up to 550 meters. Optical table: ER min 9 dB; Coupled Power Ratio (CPR) min 9 dB; Total Jitter footnote [1] with BER=10^-12 at 1.25 Gbps, PRBS 2^7-1, NRZ, compliant with ANSI X3.297 / FC-PH-2. Ordering variants include Roughrider RR K-S-T2xx shell/mounting/temperature options (H/M: -40 to 85°C).
